test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

The captain announced, “The flight will be delayed due to bad weather.”

options.text: The captain announced that the flight would be delay due to bad weather.
The captain announced that the flight would be delayed due to bad weather.
The captain announced that the fight was delayed due to bad weather.
The captain announced that the flight will be delayed due to bad weather.

solution:
​The correct answer is **'****The captain announced that the flight would be delayed due to bad weather.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 
 The given sentence is an **assertive sentence**.
